items.name: statistical-arbitrage
items.description: The Quantitative Strategy Analysis project aims to provide  analysts with tools to research, backtest, and analyze various trading strategies involving currency pairs and ETFs. With Python notebooks, historical datasets, and performance reporting tools, this project is designed to streamline quantitative research

items.name: ETF-Pairs-Trading-Simulator
items.description: Python implementation of an ETF pairs trading strategy using cointegration, OLS hedge ratios, and mean-reversion signals — with full backtesting and performance visualization.

items.name: Cointegration-Pairs-Trading
items.description: Cointegration-based ETF statistical arbitrage with a bias-controlled backtest: point-in-time pair selection, walk-forward optimization, and a model-risk suite (Newey-West HAC, block bootstrap, Deflated Sharpe) showing the apparent edge is indistinguishable from multiple-testing noise.

items.name: Pair-Trader-Engine-
items.description: PairTraderEngine is a C++ application for statistical arbitrage (pairs trading) on ETFs like QQQ & XLK. Load CSV price data, compute hedge ratios, analyze spreads, generate Z-scores, and backtest strategies with outputs including cumulative P&L, trades, and optional equity curve visualization.

items.name: quant-strategy-backtest
items.description: sample code for ETF arbitrage, multi-factor strategy, pair trading

items.name: pairs-trading
items.description: US ETF pairs trading: cointegration screening, walk-forward backtesting, bid-ask costs, and regime analysis

items.name: pairs-trading-backtest-pipeline
items.description: A robust, fault-tolerant backtesting pipeline designed for a mixed ETF-Equity universe. This project focuses on research hygiene, auditability, and overfitting control using strict walk-forward validation and CSCV/PBO analysis

items.name: pairs-trading-sector-etf
items.description: Research repo for a cointegration-based pairs trading strategy on U.S. sector ETFs. Includes data fetchers, OU mean-reversion modeling, backtesting with realistic costs, and reproducible Jupyter notebooks plus final paper.

items.name: pairs-trading-kalman
items.description: Pairs trading backtest comparing static OLS, Kalman-filtered, and rolling OLS hedge ratios with GARCH volatility on ETF pairs (2017–2025)

items.name: Mean-Reverting-Pairs-Trading-Strategy
items.description: A full-pipeline implementation of statistical arbitrage via mean-reverting pairs trading, covering cointegration testing, signal generation, and backtesting on commodity ETF pairs.

items.name: statarb-pairs-trading
items.description: Quantitative Statistical Arbitrage Pairs Trading Engine in Python. Implements Engle-Granger cointegration, OLS regression, OU half-life modeling, and dynamic rolling Z-score backtesting on EWA/EWC ETFs.

items.name: IBKR-TWS-QUANT-STRATEGIES
items.description: Quantitative trading strategy using Interactive Brokers TWS API. Includes scripts for data collection, pairs trading with cointegration and error correction model, options chain and Greeks analysis, and real-time monitoring/backtesting of ETF, crypto and equity strategies.

items.name: LASE
items.description: A high-performance statistical arbitrage system designed for pair-trading highly correlated ETFs. The engine uses Python for backtesting and statistical modelling, with the critical, low-latency Z-score signal generation kernel implemented and optimised in C++ using pybind11.
